description: Header file implementing inline functions and template methods for postfix expression evaluation in the Google Breakpad project, including stack management, token evaluation, and memory dereferencing.

classes.name: AutoStackClearer
classes.description: Helper class to ensure the evaluation stack is cleared upon function exit.

methods.name: EvaluateToken
methods.description: Evaluates a single token in the postfix expression, performing operations or pushing literals/identifiers onto the stack.

methods.name: EvaluateInternal
methods.description: Tokenizes and processes the entire postfix expression.

methods.name: Evaluate
methods.description: Public method to evaluate an expression, ensuring stack cleanup and checking for incomplete execution.

methods.name: EvaluateForValue
methods.description: Evaluates an expression expecting a single result value.

methods.name: PopValueOrIdentifier
methods.description: Pops the top element from the stack, interpreting it as a value or identifier.

methods.name: PopValue
methods.description: Pops a value from the stack, resolving identifiers via the dictionary if necessary.

methods.name: PopValues
methods.description: Pops two values from the stack for binary operations.

methods.name: PushValue
methods.description: Pushes a value onto the evaluation stack.
